reason: Both conversations correctly steered the homeowner to the filter and upper spray arm with sensible safety reminders and neither pushed parts, but Conversation 1 carried the job through to a verified result: it had the customer run a normal (longer) programme, confirmed the dishes came out clean, and explicitly closed with 'no replacement parts required'.
